theorems.name: Submission.dohr_locally_lp_of_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H h : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), ContinuousOn h U → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, H x = h x) → ∀ p : ℝ, 0 < p → V.LocallyLp H p
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
